description.value: Citrus Cycles is an appointment-based eBike specialist in Chemainus on Vancouver Island, focusing on high-quality European pedal-assist eBikes and recumbent electric trikes from brands such as Bosch-equipped models. They offer eBike rentals for visitors wanting to explore the area, and a mobile demo service that can bring bikes to prospective buyers across much of BC. The shop carries a broad range of eBike parts, batteries, chargers, accessories, and clothing.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Citrus Cycles as an active eBike specialist in Chemainus offering sales, rentals, and appointment-based service. The service page explicitly states their repair department is 'currently available exclusively to our customers' who purchased bikes from them, which is the primary basis for the walk-in and same-day repair determinations. eBike rentals are confirmed in the FAQ ('we also offer rentals on some of our eBikes') and a full eBike service offering is confirmed via the detailed tune-up package description, though restricted to Citrus Cycles purchasers only.
concerns: Service department is explicitly restricted to customers who purchased bikes from Citrus Cycles; touring cyclists who did not buy from them cannot receive repairs.
All visits require an appointment — drop-in availability is not confirmed.
Customer service page lists a secondary toll-free number (888-342-0102) not present in OSM or the main site header; primary local number 250-245-0402 is used throughout the rest of the site.
OSM had no phone number on record; phone sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Citrus Cycles is an active, legitimate eBike retailer offering rentals in Chemainus — a useful listing for touring cyclists interested in eBike rentals or accessory purchases, with a clear caveat that mechanical service is restricted to their own customers.

Same-day urgent repairs.detail: Service department is exclusively for customers who purchased from Citrus Cycles; all visits are appointment-based and non-customers are explicitly turned away

E-bike service.detail: Full eBike tune-up service confirmed, including Bosch eBike inspection and diagnostic report, drivetrain cleaning, brake adjustments, and wheel truing — available exclusively to customers who purchased their eBike from Citrus Cycles

Bike rentals.detail: FAQ confirms: 'we also offer rentals on some of our eBikes'; Rentals is listed as a dedicated navigation category on the website

wow_evidence: eBike specialist in Chemainus... we also offer rentals on some of our eBikes
